title: 第025章 还有这种操作第026章 见义勇为不行么
lines: 李隆景话语刚落，苏恒也精神一震时，许仲远则笑着拿出了一个储物戒指，“苏恒，你在大赛里胜出，成为大一第一人，可以在一周后参加校队竞赛，按惯例也会得到这一份奖励的。”
“不过我根据你的具体情况，也调整了一下奖品内容。”
苏恒激动了，惯例中的第一名奖励，他肯定不会拒绝，道谢一声接了储物戒指，略一感知后他就狂喜起来。
戒指是一个拥有十立方米空间的次空间，面积不大不小，里面则有一张银行卡，几瓶丹药。
丹药名字，一个是化境丹，这是灵化境最知名的突破类丹药，在灵化五重巅峰之前，能有七成概率无后患帮你突破一个瓶颈。
药瓶里足足三颗化境丹。
现在苏恒灵化二重巅峰，随便一颗都能让他无后患七成概率突破，晋升三重。
除了化境丹，剩下一瓶是聚灵丹，足足十颗，聚灵丹这东西最主要是提升修为，三颗就能让他初入三重的修为，提升到三重巅峰。
这还不止，普通的提升类丹药，短短时间提升出的修为会充满燥乱感，也不稳定，需要修炼者一点点打磨适应，才能彻底掌控，你花费的时间也不好说。
但聚灵丹是最完美的提升类丹药，只要运转木神功消化药力后，暴增的修为就会被你完美掌控，不需要一点点打磨适应。
一周后校队名额赛？
这一周时间，苏恒有了这13颗丹药，有八九成把握晋升到灵化三重巅峰，若效率更好的话，比如吞服化境丹第一颗就成功突破，他说不定还有机会晋升到灵化四重。
“卡里有一百万大明币，足以让购买到不错的资源。”
许仲远新的话语讲出，苏恒又激动了，身为全球第一帝国，灯塔也要比大明弱上一部分，最主要是大明有崇祯大帝那位远游星空的灾变境强者，国际上若大明和灯塔产生冲突，即便灾变之下灯塔实力丝毫不弱，依旧没底子和大明竞争的。
第一帝国的货币，购买力超强！
就说苏家，原本的苏恒父母只是做点小生意，一家人月入两三千大明币就能三口人衣食无忧了，还能给苏恒生活费。
这足以看出大明币的购买力，一百万绝对是一笔巨款！
这就成百万富翁了？这一次的奖励，也明显超出了以往大一届第一名不少。
不过他明白，这是学校明白了他的潜力，加大了投资。
想了想苏恒没有拒绝，再次道谢后就运转功法，炼化了储物戒指，他本身就是想靠着考试，争取到学校重视，然后去救父亲的，既然接受了学校的帮助，接受学校发挥人脉帮他父亲恢复健康，那么接受了一点，剩余的就没必要拒绝了。
说笑客气一番，李隆景才插口道，“苏恒，我们现在出发？你们云廊距离省城足足一千多里，乘坐最快的高铁也要一两个小时，现在去的话，还能赶上你父亲接受治疗恢复清醒的那一刻。”
19年养育恩，父亲受到那样残酷的羞辱和折磨，苏恒当然想守着父亲清醒。
云廊县，华灯初上的云廊，各式各样的现代化建筑和灯火，把一个县城的照耀犹如最璀璨的夜幕下明珠城。
这是一个县城，但全县三四千万人口，县下乡镇只有一千多万人，剩余两千万全部居住在县里，一个云廊县城，比上辈子苏恒见过的东方明珠东海市还发达。
毕竟，这是一个修炼和科技结合的世界。
县城西部一片依山傍水的豪华别墅区，许家大宅足足占地近百里，靠近中央的一座宽大别墅内，灯火通明的别墅大厅，一道道时尚动人的倩影正跳着火爆的舞蹈，吸引多道火热的视线。
许安弘高举主座，怀里还躺着一个绝色佳人为他喂食。
在左右几个单独的桌案后，是几个或青或中的男子，不断饮酒说笑，还有一个身影恭敬站在许安弘身侧，小声汇报着什么。
这身影是半个月前抵达省城江州，在江州理工外袭击了苏恒一次的杜欢。
杜欢汇报结束，许安弘才眉头微皱，“你确定？江县令插手，带走了苏震？”
content_en:
As soon as Li Longjing finished speaking and Su Heng was shocked, Xu Zhongyuan smiled and took out a storage ring, "Su Heng, if you win the competition and become the number one freshman, you can participate in the school team competition a week later. As usual, you will also get this reward."
"However, I have also adjusted the contents of the prize based on your specific situation."
Su Heng was excited. He would definitely not refuse the customary reward for first place. He thanked him and accepted the storage ring. After feeling it for a moment, he became ecstatic.
The ring is a subspace with ten cubic meters of space, not too big or too small. There is a bank card and several bottles of elixirs inside.
Among the names of the elixirs, one is Realm Transformation Pill, which is the most well-known breakthrough elixir in the Spiritual Transformation Realm. Before reaching the fifth level of spiritual transformation, it can help you break through a bottleneck with a 70% chance of being trouble-free.
There are three realm-transformation pills in the medicine bottle.
Now that Su Heng has reached the peak of the second level, any one of them will give him a 70% chance of breaking through and advancing to the third level without any future troubles.
In addition to the Realm Transformation Pill, the remaining bottle is of ten Spirit-Gathering Pills. The main purpose of the Spirit-Gathering Pill is to improve his cultivation level. Three pills can take him to the peak of the third level.
That's not all. Ordinary improvement elixirs can improve the cultivation level in a short period of time, which will be full of confusion and instability. It requires a little bit of polishing and adaptation by the cultivator before it can be completely controlled. It's hard to say how much time you spend.
But the Spirit-Gathering Pill is the most perfect elixir for improvement. As long as you use the Wood Divine Technique to digest the potency, your dramatically increased cultivation level will be perfectly controlled by you, without the need for a little bit of polishing and adaptation.
The school team qualifying game in a week?
In this week, Su Heng had these 13 pills, and he was 80-90% sure of being promoted to the third level of spiritual transformation. If the efficiency was better, such as successfully breaking through after swallowing the first transformation pill, he might still have a chance to be promoted to the fourth level of spiritual transformation.
"There is one million Daming coins in the card, which is enough to buy good resources."
Xu Zhongyuan's new words made Su Heng excited again. As the world's first empire, Lighthouse was weaker than the Ming Dynasty. The most important thing was that the Ming Dynasty had Emperor Chongzhen, a powerful man in the Cataclysm Realm who traveled far into the stars. If there was a conflict between the Ming Dynasty and Lighthouse in the world, even if the Lighthouse's strength was not weak at all under the Catastrophe, it still had no basis to compete with the Ming Dynasty.
The currency of the First Empire has super purchasing power!
Let's talk about the Su family. Originally, Su Heng's parents only ran a small business. Their monthly income of two to three thousand Ming coins was enough for the three of them to have enough food and clothing, and they could also provide Su Heng with living expenses.
This is enough to show the purchasing power of Daming Coin. One million is definitely a huge sum of money!
Does this make you a millionaire? The reward this time is obviously much higher than the first place in the previous freshman class.
But he understood that this was because the school understood his potential and increased investment.
After thinking for a while, Su Heng did not refuse. After thanking him again, he started to use his skills and refined the storage ring. He wanted to rely on the exam to win the school's attention and then save his father. Since he accepted the school's help and accepted the school's connections to help his father recover, he accepted a little and there was no need to reject the rest.
After joking and being polite, Li Longjing interrupted, "Su Heng, shall we leave now? Your Yunlang is more than a thousand miles away from the provincial capital, and it takes an hour or two by the fastest high-speed train. If we go now, we can catch up with the moment when your father receives treatment and regains consciousness."
After raising En for 19 years, his father was so cruelly humiliated and tortured. Of course Su Heng wanted to keep his father awake.
………………
In Yungang County, when the lanterns are first lit, the various modern buildings and lights make the county shine like a pearl city under the most dazzling night.
This is a county town, but the county has a population of 30 to 40 million. There are only more than 10 million people in the towns and villages under the county, and the remaining 20 million people all live in the county. Yunglang County town is more developed than Donghai City, the Oriental Pearl that Su Heng saw in his previous life.
After all, this is a world where cultivation and technology combine.
In the western part of the county, there is a luxurious villa area surrounded by mountains and rivers. The Xu family's mansion covers an area of ​​nearly a hundred miles. In a large villa near the center, in the brightly lit villa hall, fashionable and attractive figures are dancing passionately, attracting many fiery eyes.
Xu Anhong held the throne high, with a stunning beauty lying in his arms feeding him.
Behind several separate desks on the left and right, there were several young and middle-aged men, drinking and joking. There was also a figure standing respectfully beside Xu Anhong, reporting something in a low voice.
This figure was Du Huan, who arrived in the provincial capital Jiangzhou half a month ago and attacked Su Heng outside Jiangzhou University of Technology.
After Du Huan finished his report, Xu Anhong frowned slightly, "Are you sure? Magistrate Jiang intervened and took Su Zhen away?"
title_en: Chapter 025: There is still such an operation. Chapter 026: Isn’t it okay to act bravely?
